reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
ٱسْمَ is accusative after the imperative سَبِّحِ as its direct object.
رَبِّكَ is genitive after ٱسْمَ in the iḍāfa ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ.
ٱلْأَعْلَى agrees with رَبِّكَ as the qualifying adjective of the divine name phrase.
The كَ suffix in رَبِّكَ is the genitive possessor attached to رَبِّ.
سَوَّىٰ is coordinated by فَ with خَلَقَ as the second verb in the ṣila sequence.
هَدَىٰ is coordinated by فَ with قَدَّرَ as the following action.
ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ is the expressed object brought out by أَخْرَجَ.
The هُۥ suffix in جَعَلَهُۥ is the object pronoun of جَعَلَ.
غُثَآءً is the accusative result complement functioning as the second object of جَعَلَهُۥ.
أَحْوَىٰ qualifies غُثَآءً as its color or state adjective.
The كَ suffix in سَنُقْرِئُكَ is the addressee object of نُقْرِئُ.
لَا negates the following verb تَنسَىٰٓ.
مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ is the exception content introduced by إِلَّا.
مَا supplies the object domain of شَآءَ within the exception phrase.
ٱللَّهُ is the explicit nominative subject of شَآءَ.
The هُۥ suffix in إِنَّهُۥ is the ism of إِنَّ.
يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ is the predicate of إِنَّهُۥ.
ٱلْجَهْرَ is the accusative direct object of يَعْلَمُ.
وَ coordinates مَا يَخْفَىٰ with ٱلْجَهْرَ in the object field of يَعْلَمُ.
مَا يَخْفَىٰ is the second object phrase governed by يَعْلَمُ.
مَا is the subject of the relative predicate يَخْفَىٰ.
The كَ suffix in نُيَسِّرُكَ is the addressee object of نُيَسِّرُ.
لْيُسْرَىٰ is governed by لِ as the goal complement of نُيَسِّرُكَ.
إِن introduces and governs the conditional clause نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ.
ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ is the feminine subject agreeing with نَّفَعَتِ.
مَن يَخْشَىٰ is the postponed subject of سَيَذَّكَّرُ.
مَن is the subject of the relative verb يَخْشَىٰ.
The suffix ـهَا in يَتَجَنَّبُهَا is the object avoided by the verb.
ٱلْأَشْقَى follows يَتَجَنَّبُهَا as the explicit masculine singular subject.
ٱلنَّارَ is the accusative object governed by يَصْلَى.
ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ agrees with ٱلنَّارَ in definiteness and feminine reference as its adjective.
The pronoun ـهَا in فِيهَا is governed by فِي as the locative complement of يَمُوتُ.
وَلَا links يَحْيَىٰ as a coordinated negated predicate with يَمُوتُ.
مَن stands after أَفْلَحَ as the subject, completed by its relative predicate تَزَكَّىٰ.
ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ is the accusative object remembered by ذَكَرَ.
رَبِّهِۦ is the genitive complement of the construct noun ٱسْمَ.
The suffix ـهِۦ in رَبِّهِۦ is the genitive possessor attached to رَبِّ.
ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا is the accusative object preferred by تُؤْثِرُونَ.
ٱلدُّنْيَا qualifies ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ and agrees with it as the definite feminine adjective.
خَيْرٌ is the nominative predicate of ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ.
وَ coordinates أَبْقَىٰ with خَيْرٌ as a parallel comparative predicate.
أَبْقَىٰ is also predicated of ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ through its coordination with خَيْرٌ.
هَٰذَا is the governed name of إِنَّ.
فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ supplies the prepositional predicate of إِنَّ.
ٱلصُّحُفِ is governed by فِى within the predicate of إِنَّ.
ٱلْأُولَىٰ qualifies ٱلصُّحُفِ as the former scriptures.
إِبْرَٰهِيمَ is the genitive complement of the construct-like صُحُفِ.
وَ coordinates مُوسَىٰ with إِبْرَٰهِيمَ as the second possessor in صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ.
مُوسَىٰ shares the genitive possessor slot of صُحُفِ through coordination with إِبْرَٰهِيمَ.
